The controller assigns host.host = params[:embeddable_host][:host], so a request omitting :host assigns nil, and the callback raises NoMethodError before validation runs, producing a 500 instead of a validation error. judged_text: The before_validation callback dereferences `self.host` with `sub!` while the model has no presence validation, so saving a record with a nil host raises NoMethodError instead of failing validation. A POST/PUT to /admin/embeddable_hosts whose `embeddable_host` payload omits the `:host` key assigns nil and crashes in the callback, returning a 500 instead of the 4xx validation error the contract implies.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/embeddable_host.rb`, the `before_validation` callback unconditionally calls `self.host.sub!(...)` twice. If `host` is `nil`, this raises `NoMethodError` before validations run. The controller `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` assigns `host.host = params[:embeddable_host][:host]`; if the `:host` key is omitted (or `embeddable_host` lacks it), `host.host` becomes `nil` and `host.save` will crash, yielding a 500 instead of a validation error response.
